location.zh: 菲尼克斯禁地 · 白虎

strategy_notes.zh: 留意对手的特殊能力，准备好阵容再挑战。

engine_notes: Body HP 50000 forXuanwu/Qinglong/Baihu is reported in period sources; Zhuque HP 50000 is a remake calibration.
Exact boss speed, defensive scaling and skill policy are not recovered. Named-move prohibitions preserve source-supported trait instant kills.
The split paralysis/fear50% rates are calibration; the source reports either status on physical attacks, not these exact probabilities.

2011 version (4399 2011-03-11): forced first move; 寄生种子 has no effect; 静电场 works. The 2013 retrospective (atk+2, unlimited PP, 50% lifesteal) conflicts with it and is not used (user decision 2026-10-19).
No source supports immunity to 极度冰点, 同生共死 or 绝命火焰 (7k7k 2011-04-26 reports it can be KOed outright), so it has none.

uncertain: Exact server IV/EV/nature, attack-stat scaling and guardian HP not recovered unless separately cited.

source_note: Historical order and specified effects are reconstructed from the cited period gameplay reports. Level 105 is the official map-table level; IV 31, zero EVs and hardy nature are explicit remake calibration; copied guardian skill sets are catalog-based, not certified historical boss loadouts.
